caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet standing on four short legs, composed of two upper doors and three lower drawers. The cabinet is rendered in various shades of brown, with darker and lighter wood tones used to emphasize the panels, edges, and decorative details. The two doors at the top have central, square, reddish-brown panels bordered by beveled frames, and the surrounding areas show rectangular and square inlays with contrasting colors, including hints of black. Vertical, turned wood columns frame each side of the cabinet's front. Below the doors, the three horizontal drawers exhibit geometric patterns highlighted with dark and light wood, each drawer featuring a single round knob. All visible sides and surfaces of the cabinet maintain consistent wood grain and texture. The background is an off-white, unshaded surface. In the lower left corner, the name "Olrich Fischer" is written in grayish letters.
title: Chest with Drawers
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
